# Ibrahim Naseef

> DevOps Engineer | Cloud Developer | AI/ML Developer

Ibrahim Naseef is a DevOps Engineer with 2 years of experience at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He specializes in CI/CD pipelines, multicloud infrastructure automation, DevSecOps, cloud architecture, and developer workflows.

## Experience

### System Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
*August 2024 – Present, Bengaluru*

- Built centralized Azure DevOps CI/CD templates for 12+ repositories.
- Integrated Checkmarx, SonarQube, Checkov, and linting quality gates.
- Automated AWS infrastructure deployments with AWS CDK, Lambda, Glue, IAM, and S3.
- Connected Azure DevOps and Jenkins workflows for multi-environment AWS deployments.
- Automated AWS Secrets Manager provisioning with Python.
- Managed Azure DevOps repository governance with Terraform.

## Skills

Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Git, GitHub, CI/CD, AWS, Azure, Terraform, AWS CDK, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Ansible, Python, Bash, MySQL, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Checkov, AI/ML, Agentic AI, LLM tools, ChatGPT, Claude, Vercel, Netlify.

## Projects

### Full-Stack Expense Tracker Application
Containerized full-stack application using multi-stage Docker builds and Docker Compose.
[github.com/Ibrahim-Naseef/Expense-Tracker-App-Docker](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Naseef/Expense-Tracker-App-Docker)

### Morphological Analysis of Dental X-Ray Images
Deep-learning system using YOLOv8 tooth detection and instance segmentation to extract morphological features from dental X-ray images. Under patent process — code, dataset, and model files are not publicly shared.
Technologies: YOLOv8, Python, Django, MySQL, Roboflow

### CodeSeek: Python Error Explorer
Streamlit debugging tool that executes uploaded Python files, captures errors, detects input prompts, and retrieves relevant Stack Overflow solutions via the Stack Exchange API.
[github.com/Ibrahim-Naseef/CodeSeek-Python-Error-Explorer](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Naseef/CodeSeek-Python-Error-Explorer)

### Vehicle Number Plate Detection
YOLOv8-based vehicle number-plate detection system with a Streamlit interface for uploading images and running trained-model predictions.
[github.com/Ibrahim-Naseef/Vehicle-NumberPlate-Detection-YOLOV8](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Naseef/Vehicle-NumberPlate-Detection-YOLOV8)
